title: Audit fifteen conditional H6 banked-invoice thresholds
body:
For the frozen H6 model, certify the largest integer helper allowance at L = 3, 5, 7 for five distinct exact target inputs. The pinned selected target gives **79,880 / 88,765 / 79,778** helpers. The twelve original cases and separate three-case full-title PR1424 appendix remain distinct. Exact adjacent endpoint and pressure bounds support the written maximality argument; synthetic controls distinguish true-root, rounded-invoice and binary64 predicates.

The package reconstructs the conditional PR606 banked invoice and preserves only its four required dependencies and upstream notices. Source/rational modes share a model and are not code-disjoint verifiers. Local isolated CPython 3.12.14 replay passes normally and under `-O`; both evidence files regenerate to their canonical hashes. Four source guards, seventeen original controls, ten appendix rejection controls and three positive-control groups pass. The authenticated launcher and deferred appendix output pass twelve local runs plus **22 execution-hardening controls in both modes**, bound to the active source. A separate GPT-6 Pro review found no substantive mathematical flaw and requested those hardenings; its full mathematical review report/checker has not been locally recovered or replayed. No human, formal-proof or hosted-CI approval is claimed.

All five registered commands also pass from the final repository package: `python3.12 -I -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/h6-banked-invoice-audit`.

These are conditional arithmetic allowances. Compensation chronology, arbitrary-dirt restoration, encoder extras, frame-zero precompensation, target cap restrictions, physical helper loading, spectators and inter-stage sharing remain unpriced or unproved. Neither a printed ratio nor these thresholds establishes physical helper capacity. No complete paid construction, 5% gate, new kappa, supplier admission or selected-record change follows. PR1424 remains a comparison target; its [parent binding/controller/invoice/geometry review obligations](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1424#issuecomment-6162623622) are not discharged here.

Revision-3 `independent-moment`, refined to this frozen conditional invoice; [claim1635](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1635). Fresh complete reads of four relevant Discussion threads and the newest 100 open PRs at 06:57:59 UTC supplement the older complete 533-PR/305-Discussion cache. No matching exact audit was identified in that bounded coverage; PR1669 quadratic screening and PR1685 idle packing concern different objects. No all-history novelty claim.

Credit Dominik Scholz / [PR606](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/606), head `048f884ea9c222faad43e8bb01e2a6863f6925d4`, and retained Niemeier/Leech lineage; DreamingOfClouds / [PR1590](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1590), head `08e134b4a0c7f04869dae703f2a2e688e53c44f0`, and published scripts at `b496aed769dd724cd1ff6b921cade626562be27b`. PR1424 is pinned at `bfe423c24555baf35dab991a8d6fe723a038945c`. Andrey Mas with substantial GPT-6 Pro research, review and source development through ChatGPT; Codex coordinated sources, audited execution and performed mechanical replay/packaging. Apache-2.0; original notices retained.
